doc: The lines typed in the input forms, as the suggestion shell reads them (panels/extra/suggestion_list.html?config=line; D-suggestions). This table is where they are written (it is not made from anything): in the order the suggestions show them, so what is used most comes first. line: the words, split on blanks; <...> and [...] are arguments (never offered, only shown), a|b is either word. desc: what the line does. in: the input forms that take it, blank-separated (frame, tree, matrix; code_editor is a :-line sent from a skin's form to its code_editor). test/suggestion.test.js checks it against command/README.md and command_map.json `line`.
